description: This file defines a report parser class for generating an analytic profit report in Odoo, including methods for retrieving user, journal, and line data related to analytic lines and invoices.

classes.name: account_analytic_profit
classes.description: A report parser class for generating analytic profit reports in Odoo.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and updates local context with helper methods.

methods.name: _user_ids
methods.description: Retrieves user records associated with given analytic lines.

methods.name: _journal_ids
methods.description: Retrieves journal records within a date range and for a specific user.

methods.name: _line
methods.description: Retrieves analytic line records based on date range, journal IDs, and user IDs, and computes profit and efficiency metrics.

methods.name: _lines
methods.description: Retrieves analytic line records for a given date range, journal IDs, and employee IDs.
